text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGER fired for inference-gateway.prod-us-west1 — error_rate_5xx > 5% over 2m (route: /v1/generate). PD incident created: INC-1718640123. Escalation chain initiated.
li chen: acked on-call. i'm looking now. can anyone confirm customer-facing 502 reports? @maria?
maria: support seeing multiple mentions from two customers in EU and NA, mainly 502 and timeouts when calling embed/gen endpoints. opening a customer-impact ticket.
samir: confirmed spike on metrics dashboard — 5xx count jumped ~7x at 1718640060. p95 latency up too. stack shows surge in kvcache miss rate.
li chen: good. first triage: are we in the middle of a model canary rollout? deploy-bot, any recent deploys to prod-us-west1?
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: rollout finished for model: text-compact-v2 canary at 1718639800 — no automatic rollback. no other infra deploys in the window.
raj: pinging infra: can we verify autoscaler health for inference-pool-usw1? if it's thrashing that could cause 502s.
li chen: running quick checks: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference-gateway -o wide` — seeing 3/5 pods ready in us-west1, rest restarting. logs show repeated "kv cache OOM" and "failed to open model shard" errors.
samir: stack snippets from logs: ```
2024-11-15T17:02:40Z ERROR inference-gateway request failed: rpc error: code = Internal desc = kvcache: shard open: out of memory
2024-11-15T17:02:41Z ERROR serve: dispatch failed: model loader timeout
```
li chen: if kvcache OOM, that explains latencies and 502 fallthroughs. mitigation plan: 1) scale dedicated pool up (+2 nodes) 2) enable fallback routing to smaller quantized variant 3) temporarily increase retry budget and lower concurrency per pod.
maria: note: tell support to set expectations — intermittent 502s, partial degradation, likely resolved in minutes. sending customer update template now.
raj: i'm triggering a scale action on dedicated pool and pushing a routing change to route 10% traffic to text-compact-v1 (lower memory) as a fallback. will monitor error rate.
samir: initiated scale: `infractl scale pool inference-pool-usw1 --add 2` — jobs accepted. routing change applied: `route set inference-gateway /v1/generate --fallback text-compact-v1 --weight 10%`.
li chen: monitoring metrics — error_rate_5xx dropped from 6.8% to 3.1% after fallback. p95 latency improving. still seeing a few restarts.
raj: i'm asking runtime team to investigate kvcache memory leak in latest loader; @samir can you collect heap profiles from one of the restarting pods? put them in /tmp/INC-1718640123 on the diagnostics bucket.
samir: collected profiles and logs, uploaded tar: gs://redwood-diagnostics/INC-1718640123/heap-profiles.tgz — added to the incident doc.
maria: customers updated: sent initial note, will follow up after stable recovery. linked support cases: #C-3321, #C-3324.
deploy-bot: PD automated escalation: 10m unresolved — escalated to SRE lead (raj).
li chen: handing off on-call in 20m to raj for post-recovery root cause and follow-up. i'm marking this thread as active and will join post-mortem.
raj: taking ownership. next steps: detailed memory tracing, rollback canary if reproducer found, and a postmortem. creating follow-up task in INC doc.
maria: closing customer loop for now; will reopen if errors reappear.
pagerbot: incident INC-1718640123 status: mitigated -> monitoring. last update 1718640600. reactions: :white_check_mark: on mitigation steps.
li chen: thanks team. added runbook link and recommended follow-ups to the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-kvcache
